title: fix(plugin-security): every delegable-scope branch leaves out the built-in identity positions
body:
Fixes #24737

Clause-②: no

## What changed

`GET /security/my-delegable-scope` answers from `DelegatedAdminGate.describeDelegableScope` (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/delegated-admin-gate.ts`). Its tenant-level branch and its delegated branch listed the four ADR-0068 D2 identity names (`platform_admin`, `org_owner`, `org_admin`, `org_member`) in `assignablePositions`. `sys_user_position.position` refuses those names from every writer with `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, so the invite dialog and Setup's position picker offered choices that could only fail. The organization-level branch already skipped them through the shared `isReservedIdentityName` predicate.

All three branches read one local listing, `allPositions()`. That listing already left out the two audience anchors. It now also leaves out the identity names, through the same `isReservedIdentityName` predicate that the write's validation is generated from. The organization-level branch's own copy of the skip is gone, because the listing it reads now does the skip once. Its behaviour is unchanged.

Unchanged, as the card bounds it:
- the write path's refusal, and the reserved list (`objects/reserved-identity-names.ts`);
- every other position in every branch;
- `placeableBusinessUnitIds`.

`packages/spec/**` and `packages/rest/**` are not touched.

## Why the shared listing, not a second copy (decision frame)

Option A applies the predicate once, in the listing all three branches read. Option B adds a skip to each of the other two branch loops, which makes three copies of one rule. Option C filters in the catalog reader (`@objectstack/core`), which would also change the metadata door, and that door is meant to list the built-ins.

- **Real business need.** The consumer is real and named on the card: objectui `InviteMemberDialog.tsx` renders `assignablePositions` verbatim. A and B serve it equally. C reaches surfaces with no such need.
- **Long-term soundness.** A keeps one rule in one place inside the report. A future fourth branch reads the same listing and inherits the skip. B is the copy-per-branch shape that produced this defect: one branch had the skip and two did not.
- **Making AI mistakes harder.** Under A, a new branch cannot forget the skip, because there is nothing to remember. Under B, the next branch has to know to add it.
- **No scope spread.** A is a one-line filter plus the deletion of a copy. It adds no new gate, no new surface and no spec change.

Recommendation: A, which is what this PR implements.

## Pin

New: `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/delegable-scope-no-identity-positions.posture.test.ts`. It runs on a real `ObjectQL` engine over a real `SqlDriver`, with the real `SecurityPlugin` registered (its own declared built-in positions included), in the postures `single`, `group` and `isolated`. There is one enumerated case per branch: tenant-level (`admin_full_access`), organization-level (`organization_admin`) and delegated (an `east_admin` placing `adminScope`). Nine cases in total. Each case asserts:

- **ground truth:**
  - the catalog this stack serves lists all four identity names and the control position (otherwise the absence check would pass over a catalog that never held them);
  - the real write refuses each identity name from the same caller with the ADR-0112 envelope `[400, VALIDATION_FAILED]` and stores nothing;
- **branch identity:** `isTenantAdmin` and the `scopes` set names show which branch answered;
- **the rule:**
  - `assignablePositions` contains none of the four names;
  - the control position `field_rep` is still listed;
  - every listed position is admitted by the real `sys_user_position` insert (`{ status: 200 }`), and the stored row is read back.

This case is modelled on the PR #24793 suite (card #24736), `delegated-admin-own-name-set.posture.test.ts`.

## Ablation (both legs at head `5e6b336871`, run under the shared verify lock)

- **Leg 1:** the listing's new predicate is removed with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. Anchor `x1 -> x0`, blob `08da6da24c92 -> 616808d66e5d`.
  - Result: `Tests  9 failed (9)`. All three branches go red, which shows the one predicate now guards the organization-level branch too. First failure: `platform_admin offered: expected [ 'platform_admin', 'org_owner', …(3) ] to not include 'platform_admin'`.
  - Restored: blob `08da6da24c92` matches HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **Leg 2:** the whole gate file is put back at the base `6b222464ce` (`git restore --source=BASE`, blob `2a202d1153`). This is the old listing plus the organization-level branch's own copy.
  - Result: `Tests  6 failed | 3 passed (9)`. The tenant-level and delegated cases are red in all three postures, and the organization-level cases are green. That is exactly the defect the card reports.
  - Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- PATH`: blob `08da6da24c92` matches HEAD, `git diff HEAD` is empty, and `git status --porcelain` is empty.

## Verification (head `5e6b336871`)

- Closure build `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/plugin-security^...' build`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- New file alone: `Tests  9 passed (9)`, test time 634 ms (measured on a shared box).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security test`: `Test Files  194 passed (194)`, `Tests  4040 passed | 45 skipped (4085)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security typecheck`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists the new test file (1 hit).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 68 families. All were run locally, each exit captured before any pipe.
  - `--ran` result: `68 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 66 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED`.
  - NOT MEASURED locally: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n`, each exit 3 `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`. They read whole-repo build output, and this run built only the plugin-security closure. CI owns both families.
- `test:repo` was not run locally. CI's `Test Core` runs it.

## Acceptance notes

- Two prose sentences outside this card's surface still say a tenant-level admin's report enumerates "everything":
  - the `DelegableScope.isTenantAdmin` TSDoc in `packages/spec/src/contracts/security-service.ts`;
  - `content/docs/permissions/delegated-administration.mdx` ("with everything enumerated").
  
  Both already excluded the audience anchors before this PR. This is wording drift only, not a defect: no reader parses those sentences. This PR's own `DelegableScopeReport` comment now says "everything the write path admits". No carrier has been named for the two sentences.
- The branch is 3 commits behind `origin/main`. None of those commits touches `plugin-security`, and CI tests the merge ref.

Related, for reference only: card #24136 and its PR #24732 (the organization-level branch's skip), and card #24736 and its PR #24793 (the delegated walk's own-name set).
